summaryZh: Contijoch 研究实验室开发转化心血管成像技术，以更好地诊断、监测并理解心脏功能障碍和血管疾病。团队开发并应用 MRI、CT 和超声心动图，重点关注右心室功能、肺血管疾病、肺动脉高压及成人先天性心脏病相关问题。
researchQuestions: 如何以成像技术理解并评估心血管生理、疾病变化和治疗反应？

evidence.quote: Contijoch Research Laboratory Dr. Francisco Contijoch
Contijoch’s primary research interests are focused on developing translational imaging techniques to better diagnose, monitor, and understand cardiac dysfunction and vascular disease.
We develop and apply novel magnetic resonance (MRI), computed tomography (CT) and echocardiography imaging techniques to better visualize function of the cardiovascular system.
We are particularly interested in the right ventricular dysfunction and pulmonary vascular disease.
Contijoch also holds an appointment in the Department of Radiology at the UC San Diego School of Medicine.
